scripts.db:migrate:deploy: DATABASE_OPERATION=migrate npm run db:safety && DATABASE_URL="$MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL" prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:migrate:status: DATABASE_OPERATION=migrate npm run db:safety && DATABASE_URL="$MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL" prisma migrate status
scripts.db:rollback:migrate: DATABASE_OPERATION=rollback npm run db:safety && DATABASE_URL="$ROLLBACK_DATABASE_URL" prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:rollback:apply: DATABASE_OPERATION=rollback npm run db:safety && prisma db execute --url "$ROLLBACK_DATABASE_URL" --file "$ROLLBACK_FILE"
scripts.prisma:drift: DATABASE_OPERATION=drift npm run db:safety && prisma migrate diff --from-migrations prisma/migrations --to-url "$MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL" --shadow-database-url "$SHADOW_DATABASE_URL" --exit-code
